label: Участок
description: A 10-sentence usage card for участок (plot; area).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Участок' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Этот' points at it, 'земли' is genitive of possession, and 'большой' is the agreeing adjective. A clean descriptive frame.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Участок' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'купили', identical to the nominative. 'Небольшой' agrees in the masculine accusative. A practical purchase sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a preposition. 'Участка' is genitive after 'около' to mark proximity. The fleeting vowel in -ток drops, giving the stem участк-. 'Нашего' agrees in the genitive.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На участке' uses the prepositional form 'участке' after 'на' to mark where the trees grow. 'Старые яблони' is the nominative plural subject. A typical garden scene.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К участку' uses the dative form 'участку' after 'к' to mark movement toward. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative. A natural sentence of motion.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with location frame. 'Участок' is nominative as the subject of 'начинается'. 'Лесной' is the agreeing adjective, and 'за домом' is instrumental location. Good for describing terrain.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after the verb. 'Участком' is instrumental, governed by 'гордится'. 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A useful pattern for expressing pride.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject in a figurative sense. 'Участок' is nominative, here meaning a stretch of road. 'Дороги' is genitive of relation, and 'опасный' agrees. Shows the noun's broader 'section' meaning.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Участки' is the nominative plural subject. 'Соседние' agrees in the plural, and 'распроданы' is the short plural participle. Good for plural practice.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Участков' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. 'Свободных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в деревне' is prepositional location. A useful quantity pattern.
